decisions.reason: The XL package is a low-cost tier extension of the established anamnesis app that the firm announced publicly as a first-time capability, so it fits the announced digital, paperless direction and nothing suggests results bad enough to write it off and admit the decision was a mistake.

The firm committed to the dedicated support service for dental assistants visibly with its own web page, and the service is central to its claim of responsive expert support, so dropping it would undercut a publicly stated strength while any weak uptake can still be put down to a temporary ramp-up.
